title: macOS: Enable PKCS #11 support when building with macos-setup.sh
description:
Enable PKCS #11 support in macOS builds with macos-setup.sh (already
supported via Homebrew) by installing p11-kit (and its dependency
libtasn1) and building nettle and GnuTLS with it.

notes.body:

@Lekensteyn, you did the original support for PKCS 11 token support (ac58eafa3223ef40b9b60765b0b3d118f338fffc), can you take a look at this? This works for me on macOS.

I just checked that macos-setup.sh runs fine and Wireshark compiles and runsfor me. I have no idea how to test the pkcs-11 functionality.

Two remarks:
1) both new packages need to be added to the "installed packages" section. Please do so.
2) nettle nowadays complains that --with-libgcrypt is an unknown parameter - maybe you can remove it while you are at it (it was most likely me who updated nettle and missed the message).

Thanks for the feedback, done and done.

The best way to test is probably (from the build directory after building):

1. `pip3 install -U pytest pytest-xdist`
2. `python3 -m pytest -k decryption`

That should pass 89 tests and skip 1 (SoftHSM). There's a test that requires PKCS 11 support.

Also the output of `tshark -v` should say something like `with GnuTLS 3.6.15 and PKCS #11 support`

I know it works for a fresh install; I'm not sure how it works if you run from a pre-existing tree that already had GnuTLS 3.6.15 built without PKCS 11 support installed.

Thanks for the hint with the output of tshark -v. I only checked wireshark and it seems to be missing there.
I deleted both nettle* and gnutls* in the macos-support-libs/ directory before running the setup script. At least the gnutls delete is really needed.
enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for fe1f9475409f252b6ca2dccc71187868e168c74b succeeds

That makes sense. As your commit 77e9d7d3f9ba64e27481710ff3effc1d5e2fbbac updated GnuTLS from 3.6.14 to 3.6.15, the only cases needing a manual delete are when someone pulled and built GnuTLS 3.6.15 in the 10 hours between that commit and this one. (Alas, would have been nice to get this in before the GnuTLS bump.)

On a related note, how does the MacOS buildbot get updated for support packages? It got the git updates of this commit and that one of yours, but the [CMake output](https://buildbot.wireshark.org/wireshark-master/builders/macOS%2010.14%20x64/builds/770/steps/compile_2/logs/stdio) still shows the old versions of everything before your commit.

@@ -150,6 +150,13 @@ if [ "$GNUTLS_VERSION" ]; then

 fi

@@ -1120,6 +1127,90 @@ uninstall_gmp() {
     fi
 }
 
+install_libtasn1() {
+    if [ "$LIBTASN1_VERSION" -a ! -f libtasn1-$LIBTASN1_VERSION-done ] ; then
+        echo "Downloading, building, and installing libtasn1:"
+        [ -f libtasn1-$LIBTASN1_VERSION.tar.gz ] || curl -L -O https://ftpmirror.gnu.org/libtasn1/libtasn1-$LIBTASN1_VERSION.tar.gz || exit 1
+        $no_build && echo "Skipping installation" && return
+        gzcat libtasn1-$LIBTASN1_VERSION.tar.gz | tar xf - || exit 1
+        cd libtasn1-$LIBTASN1_VERSION
+        CFLAGS="$CFLAGS $VERSION_MIN_FLAGS $SDKFLAGS" CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS $VERSION_MIN_FLAGS $SDKFLAGS" LDFLAGS="$LDFLAGS $VERSION_MIN_FLAGS $SDKFLAGS" ./configure || exit 1
+        make $MAKE_BUILD_OPTS || exit 1
+        $DO_MAKE_INSTALL || exit 1
+        cd ..
+        touch libtasn1-$LIBTASN1_VERSION-done
+    fi
+}
+
+uninstall_libtasn1() {
+    if [ ! -z "$installed_libtasn1_version" ] ; then
+        #
+        # p11-kit depends on this, so uninstall it.
+        #
+        uninstall_p11_kit "$@"
+
+        echo "Uninstalling libtasn1:"
+        cd nettle-$installed_libtasn1_version
+        $DO_MAKE_UNINSTALL || exit 1
+        make distclean || exit 1
+        cd ..
+        rm libtasn1-$installed_libtasn1_version-done
+
+        if [ "$#" -eq 1 -a "$1" = "-r" ] ; then
+            #
+            # Get rid of the previously downloaded and unpacked version.
+            #
+            rm -rf libtasn1-$installed_libtasn1_version
+            rm -rf libtasn1-$installed_libtasn1_version.tar.gz
+        fi
+
+        installed_libtasn1_version=""
+    fi
+}
+
+install_p11_kit() {
+    if [ "$P11KIT_VERSION" -a ! -f p11-kit-$P11KIT_VERSION-done ] ; then
+        echo "Downloading, building, and installing p11-kit:"
+        [ -f p11-kit-$P11KIT_VERSION.tar.xz ] || curl -L -O https://github.com/p11-glue/p11-kit/releases/download/$P11KIT_VERSION/p11-kit-$P11KIT_VERSION.tar.xz || exit 1
+        $no_build && echo "Skipping installation" && return
+        xzcat p11-kit-$P11KIT_VERSION.tar.xz | tar xf - || exit 1
+        cd p11-kit-$P11KIT_VERSION
+        # Same hack for libffi missing pkg-config files as GLib
+        includedir=`xcrun --show-sdk-path 2>/dev/null`/usr/include
+        LIBFFI_CFLAGS="-I $includedir/ffi" LIBFFI_LIBS="-lffi" CFLAGS="$CFLAGS $VERSION_MIN_FLAGS $SDKFLAGS" CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS $VERSION_MIN_FLAGS $SDKFLAGS" LDFLAGS="$LDFLAGS $VERSION_MIN_FLAGS $SDKFLAGS" ./configure --without-trust-paths || exit 1
+        make $MAKE_BUILD_OPTS || exit 1
+        $DO_MAKE_INSTALL || exit 1
+        cd ..
+        touch p11-kit-$P11KIT_VERSION-done
+    fi
+}
+
+uninstall_p11_kit() {
+    if [ ! -z "$installed_p11_kit_version" ] ; then
+        #
+        # Nettle depends on this, so uninstall it.
+        #
+        uninstall_nettle "$@"
+
+        echo "Uninstalling p11-kit:"
+        cd p11-kit-$installed_p11_kit_version
+        $DO_MAKE_UNINSTALL || exit 1
+        make distclean || exit 1
+        cd ..
+        rm p11-kit-$installed_p11_kit_version-done
+
+        if [ "$#" -eq 1 -a "$1" = "-r" ] ; then
+            #
+            # Get rid of the previously downloaded and unpacked version.
+            #
+            rm -rf p11-kit-$installed_p11_kit_version
+            rm -rf p11-kit-$installed_p11_kit_version.tar.xz
+        fi
+
+        installed_p11_kit_version=""
+    fi
+}
+
 install_nettle() {
     if [ "$NETTLE_VERSION" -a ! -f nettle-$NETTLE_VERSION-done ] ; then
         echo "Downloading, building, and installing Nettle:"

-        CFLAGS="$CFLAGS $VERSION_MIN_FLAGS $SDKFLAGS" CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS $VERSION_MIN_FLAGS $SDKFLAGS" LDFLAGS="$LDFLAGS $VERSION_MIN_FLAGS $SDKFLAGS" ./configure --with-libgcrypt --without-p11-kit || exit 1

@@ -2249,6 +2340,28 @@ install_all() {

commits_data.title: macOS: Enable PKCS #11 support when building with macos-setup.sh
commits_data.message:
macOS: Enable PKCS #11 support when building with macos-setup.sh

Enable PKCS #11 support in macOS builds with macos-setup.sh (already
supported on macOS via Homebrew and on all other OSes with GnuTLS 3.4
or greater) by installing p11-kit (and its dependency libtasn1) and
building nettle and GnuTLS against it.
